question: What will the amount after 1 year be, if ₹2,400 is invested at 20% compound interest per annum, compounded half-yearly?
solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹2,400

Rate of interest (r) = 20% per annum

Compounding frequency = Half-yearly (2 times in a year)

Time (t) = 1 year

**Formula used:**

A = P(1+(r)/(n×100))ⁿ×t
